summary: Medalist Diversified, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its Mira Sav joint venture, entered September 1, 2026 with Spandrel Development Partners and insiders Frank Kavanaugh and Emanuel Neuman, closed a $13.8 million construction loan on October 9, 2026 through subsidiary MIRA Sav Property, LLC with lender GLP 2505 LLC. The company committed $4.0 million for roughly 42% preferred equity; Spandrel holds 37% and the two insiders 11% each. Terms include $5.05 million initial funding, $8.75 million construction reserve, 11.5% interest floor, October 2027 maturity with three extension options. Watch related-party governance and guaranty exposure.
